scope: Only explicit node-0/1/2 identity records and optional load identity record. cgroup counters describe the sampler's current visible v1/v2 leaves, not their hidden ancestors. Network counters describe the sampler's network namespace, not individual processes. Raw counters are cumulative; use monotonic deltas for rates. Null/errors are unavailable, not zero. CPU ticks use clockTicksPerSecond; status *Bytes/io *_bytes/network bytes are bytes; rchar/wchar are bytes; syscr/syscw are syscall counts; v2 cpu.stat *_usec are microseconds. v1 cpu.stat throttled_time/burst_time and cpuacct.usage are nanoseconds; v1 cpuacct.stat user/system are USER_HZ ticks. memory.failcnt is allocation failures, not OOM kills. Wall clocks are not verified synchronized and do not establish one-way latency.
